ev.q: identified contaminated methylene blue used as a tissue-marking agent as the source of infection
Of the four cases identified initially, three were confirmed, and one was suspect; no additional cases were identified.
Two patients had had previous facial cosmetic surgery; none had an immunocompromising medical condition.
The median time from surgical procedure to onset of clinically apparent infection was 30 days (range: 18--34 days).
The median age of the women was 56 years (range: 44--69 years).
NJDHSS conducted an epidemiologic, environmental, and microbiologic investigation.

methods_quotes.q: Cases were classified as confirmed, probable, or suspect.
Molecular typing, using random amplification of polymorphic DNA, indicated that the methylene blue and wound isolates were the same strain.
